extraction_text: to introduce new, different or improved methods of transportation, maintenance, service and operation

It is agreed, if a streetcar line is replaced by buses, that the regular operators of the streetcar line will transfer to the new bus line and pick regular runs in accordance with full seniority, provided, however, that if more bus operators are needed to operate this new bus line, then such additional operators as are needed will be transferred. Regular operators shall work such runs until the next general pick of runs of the Division is held, when they shall take their positions in accordance with full seniority.
